--Alma Neighborhood Center
This project provides $240,000 for construction of the Alma Neighborhood Center.
Alviso CNRA:
This is the continuation of a capital improvements program begun in the previous three-year CDBG effort. (Refer to Fiture #4) No CDBG-funded housing rehabilitation activities are proposed for the three years.
N: State Street
E: Spreckles Street; Wilson Way
S: Grand Street
W: Taylor Street
--Storm Drains and Streets
Fourth and fifth year funds will be used to complete the storm drainage system in Alviso and improve the streets. In the 4th year, funds are recommended for completion of the drainage system for the residential area, including drainage of State Street (Essex to Spreckles). Wabash Street (Pacific to Spreckles), Michigan Street (Pacific to Spreckles), and Pacific Street (State to Michigan). Street improvements will also be provided on Wabash Street (200' of Pacific to Spreckles), Michigan Street (Essex to Spreckles) and Pacific Street (State to Grand).
In the fifth year, curbs, gutters, sidewalks and lighting are proposed for all residential streets previously graded and paved in the internal area (not including State, Spreckles, Grand) and Michigan (West of Archer).
--Wilson Way
Improvements would include street resurfacing, sidewalks, curbs and gutters to Wilson Way.
--Clean-Up Program
Funds will be provided to implement a "clean-up" program in Alviso and the immediate surrounding area. Financial incentives for the removal of junk cars and applicances, large trash bins and advertising would also be provided.
-- Park Improvements
This project will provide cyclone fencing along Park Avenue and Wilson Way; lighting around the baseball diamond and lights and trees along Wilson Way, as needed.
